title.zh: 把视觉概念做成可以观看的短片。
title.en: Turning a visual concept into a short.

paragraphs.zh: 作品以动画风格的角色特写、屋顶对峙和领域变化组织视觉片段，通过能量效果、漂浮物与画面切换展示角色冲突。
paragraphs.en: The short combines animation-style close-ups, a rooftop confrontation and changing domains, using energy effects, floating objects and scene transitions to present conflict.

paragraphs.zh: 我使用 ComfyUI 与 MiniMax H3 制作这段视频，将它作为 AI 影像创作与视觉概念呈现的实践作品。
paragraphs.en: I created this video with ComfyUI and MiniMax H3 as a practice in AI filmmaking and visual concept presentation.

paragraphs.zh: 本页展示完整短片，约 30.6 秒，1080p、30 fps，保留音轨。网页播放版本经过压缩，便于访问和播放。
paragraphs.en: This page presents the complete 30.6-second short at 1080p and 30 fps, with its audio track. The web version is compressed for convenient playback.

paragraphs.zh: 画面由生成式 AI 工具制作，作品侧重概念镜头与视觉效果的表达，作为游戏策划之外的影像创作实践。
paragraphs.en: The visuals were created with generative AI tools. This experiment focuses on concept shots and visual effects as a filmmaking practice alongside game design.

next.zh: 后续可补充制作过程与迭代对照。
next.en: A future update may document the process and compare iterations.
